_about: Google Trends interest-by-subregion, captured via the Trends Explore UI on 2026-06-15. 12-month window, Web Search, one combined OR query per axis (single search item, so values are cross-region interest, NOT the multi-term 'shares trap'). Index 0-100, region with highest interest = 100, relative share-of-search not absolute volume.

queries.direct_intent: natural deodorant + aluminium free deodorant + refillable deodorant + plastic free deodorant
queries.unaware_intent: clean beauty + zero waste + plastic free + shampoo bar + low tox

notes: AU: all 8 states report direct + unaware. NZ direct intent is low-volume: only 10/16 regions cleared Google's reporting threshold and the series has ~35/53 zero weeks (hence low NZ Z). Regions with no direct data are imputed direct=0. Gisborne and West Coast reported neither axis; their unaware is imputed to a low floor (40). Marlborough tops NZ direct at 100 on a tiny sample (low-population inflation) and is flagged.

Gisborne.flag: no Trends data either axis; imputed

West Coast.flag: no Trends data either axis; imputed
